note: On the east shore of Grand Isle (South Hero Island) in Lake Champlain, in two wooded loops behind a steep, tree-covered shore bank lined with lean-tos. The A loop's lakeside prime row (sites 1-8) is 20-ft or tent-only, so site choice matters for a 23-ft rig; the longer sites are inland. Camping-only park (no day use): registered campers get a PIN for the security gate, and should arrive during office hours. --Claude
